result.reason: The operative text establishes a mutual greater-of cap with a USD 1,000,000 floor, but it does not fully reach the playbook. It measures the fee period preceding the event giving rise to the claim rather than the claim, and uses broader “all amounts” language instead of fees. More importantly, the supplied operative language contains no mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages, no verifiable definition of “Excluded Claims” establishing the required carve-outs, and no clarification that Customer payment obligations are not damages. The margin comment cannot cure those omissions. The revision otherwise preserves unrelated commercial terms, but broadening the metric from fees to all amounts is more than necessary and potentially captures non-fee payments.
